# Guest Room Damage Report — 06/18/2026
Highland Harbor Hotel | Housekeeping shift report

## Report details
- Reported by: Maria Okafor, room attendant
- Supervisor: Wendy Ellison
- Room: 814
- Inspection time: 10:20 AM
- Guest checkout: 10:05 AM
- Report logged: 10:34 AM

## Damage observed
At 10:20 AM, I found a cracked glass bedside lamp base on the dresser in Room 814. The lamp shade was intact, and the cord was unplugged. Three ceramic pieces were on the dresser; no loose fragments were visible on the carpet. I photographed the lamp in place before moving it. The room inventory lists the lamp base replacement value as $48.00.

The damage was discovered after checkout, before the room was cleaned or assigned to another guest. I placed the lamp pieces in a labeled bag and left the bag in the housekeeping office for supervisor review. No guest belongings were moved or discarded. The room was marked out of service pending inspection.

## Notification and follow-up
Highland Harbor Hotel procedure requires the room attendant to notify the supervisor about damage before leaving the floor and record the notification time in the shift log.
- Supervisor notification: no entry in the shift log.
- At 10:34 AM, I entered the damage in the housekeeping log and attached two photographs.
- Gordon Quinn, front desk associate, confirmed that Room 814 had no new guest assignment at the time of the report.
- Replacement estimate: $84.00, based on the room inventory.
- The room remains out of service until Wendy Ellison inspects the dresser area and releases it for cleaning.

## Disposition
The lamp pieces were stored in a labeled bag with the room number and discovery time noted. No charge was posted to the guest account; the supervisor will review the circumstances and determine any follow-up with the front desk.
